note: Times are in the source video. Subtitles are our English translation of the farmer's dialect: a Bangla speaker should check them. Q = our interviewer (shown in italics), A = the farmer.
label: Field interview · October 2026
subtitles: Do you use a mobile? A smartphone or a button phone?
No, I use this button phone.
When an SMS comes, can you read it?
No, no, I can't. I only talk on calls.
Last year you grew potatoes. Who did you sell them to?
At the haat. We sell, but we never make the money we should.
Some years profit, some years loss.
